text: Cycling is an efficient and environmentally friendly means of transportation that allows you to explore new places and enjoy the outdoors. Whether you are a seasoned professional or a casual rider, understanding cycling’s fundamentals is crucial. One of the most important aspects of cycling is understanding the gears. Gears play a significant role in determining the speed and effort you can exert on your bicycle. With the right gear ratio, you can cruise at a comfortable pace or accelerate rapidly. Proper gear selection is vital for maintaining balance and ensuring smooth rides. Cycling also requires wearing a helmet, which protects your head in case of an unexpected incident. Additionally, proper cycling attire, such as shorts and a padded jersey, complements your safety gear and provides comfort during extended rides.
